user_saw: The Signal channel still showed as connected after a silent network drop, but new messages stopped arriving.
summary: The fix adds a WebSocket keepalive that terminates an unresponsive Signal container receive socket so the existing loop can reconnect, with timeout enforcement suspended while reads are locally paused.
reasoning: The oldest readable snapshot already relied on the WebSocket close event to reconnect and had no heartbeat to detect a silent drop after opening. This suggests the transport may have shipped with the defect, but the offline history stopped at a missing object before I could verify the introducing diff.
